column1: # Dependencies may stay within one layer when acyclic or point to a lower
# numeric layer. Upward edges and every cycle are rejected.
# Literal eval commands are inventoried separately in
# Exact internal module edges. Additions and removals both require updating
# this inventory so dependency spread is an explicit architecture decision.
# Owner-prefixed result channels read outside their owner. These are approved
# hot stateful return paths; additions and removals both ratchet exactly.
